title: Happy sloth
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' fill='none'>
  <!-- Branch -->
  <rect x='2' y='28' width='96' height='10' rx='5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='2' y='28' width='96' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A0703B'/>
  <!-- Leaf left -->
  <ellipse cx='14' cy='24' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#2E9E4F' transform='rotate(-20 14 24)'/>
  <ellipse cx='14' cy='24' rx='5' ry='2.5' fill='#3BBF65' transform='rotate(-20 14 24)'/>
  <!-- Leaf right -->
  <ellipse cx='86' cy='24' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#2E9E4F' transform='rotate(20 86 24)'/>
  <ellipse cx='86' cy='24' rx='5' ry='2.5' fill='#3BBF65' transform='rotate(20 86 24)'/>
  <!-- Arms hanging from branch -->
  <rect x='30' y='34' width='9' height='20' rx='4.5' fill='#9A7A5A'/>
  <rect x='61' y='34' width='9' height='20' rx='4.5' fill='#9A7A5A'/>
  <rect x='27' y='48' width='15' height='8' rx='4' fill='#B08D6A'/>
  <rect x='58' y='48' width='15' height='8' rx='4' fill='#B08D6A'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#B08D6A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='19' ry='13' fill='#C9A97F'/>
  <!-- Belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#E8D5B8'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#B08D6A'/>
  <!-- Face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#E8D5B8'/>
  <!-- Dark eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='48' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#5A3E2B'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='48' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#5A3E2B'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='48' r='3' fill='#FFF3E0'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='48' r='3' fill='#FFF3E0'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='48' r='1.6' fill='#3D2B1F'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='48' r='1.6' fill='#3D2B1F'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='47' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='47' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#5A3E2B'/>
  <!-- Happy smile -->
  <path d='M43 58 Q50 64 57 58' stroke='#5A3E2B' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='55' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#E8A0A0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='55' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#E8A0A0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='82' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#B08D6A'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='82' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#B08D6A'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='82' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#C9A97F'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='82' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#C9A97F'/>
  <!-- Claws on feet -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='84' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#E8D5B8'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='86' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#E8D5B8'/>
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='86' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#E8D5B8'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='86' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#E8D5B8'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='86' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#E8D5B8'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='84' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#E8D5B8'/>
  <!-- Claws on hands -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='55' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#E8D5B8'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='57' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#E8D5B8'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='57' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#E8D5B8'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='55' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#E8D5B8'/>
</svg>
